trap-negation-contrast.notes: No constructions from the ten categories. NOT A TRAP, reported separately: the braid-word column mixes two strand conventions inside one T(2,q) family. T_{2,1} = sigma_0 and T_{2,2} = sigma_0^2 are correct 2-strand words, but T_{2,3} = sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_0 and T_{2,5} = (sigma_0 sigma_1)^2 sigma_0 are 3-strand words whose closures have 2 components each, whereas T(2,3) (trefoil) and T(2,5) (cinquefoil) are knots; the 2-strand words are sigma_0^3 and sigma_0^5. Crossing counts (3 and 5) are right, which is what makes the strand-count error visible.
